lead.zh: 按基础、训练、架构与生成顺序读十二个主题。重点是解释现象和限制；技术细节可在需要时回查。
lead.en: Read twelve topics across foundations, training, architecture and generation. Focus on explaining behavior and limits; revisit details when needed.

steps: 大模型 - 大语言模型

zh: 说出 Transformer 处理一句话的大致流程：切词 → 变向量 → 注意力 → 逐词生成
说清聊天模型的训练三阶段，每一阶段各解决什么问题
解释模型为什么会一本正经地编，以及上下文为什么越大越贵
en: Walk through how a Transformer handles a sentence: split, embed, attend, generate one token at a time
Explain the three training stages of a chat model and what each stage solves
Say why a model fabricates confidently, and why bigger context costs more

answers.zh: 对自回归语言模型，可概括为分词、嵌入、带注意力的多层计算、得到下一个 Token 的分布，再选择并继续生成。这是简图，不代表每一种 Transformer 的任务流程。
answers.en: For an autoregressive language model: tokenize, embed, apply layers with attention, obtain a next-token distribution, select a token and repeat. This sketch does not describe every Transformer task.

answers.zh: 常见聊天模型流程包括预训练、监督微调和偏好优化：分别学习基础模式、任务与回答形式、偏好或约束。具体模型可能合并、重复或省略阶段。
answers.en: A common chat-model recipe uses pretraining, supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization: general patterns, task/response formats, and preferences or constraints. Actual recipes can merge, repeat or omit stages.

answers.zh: 生成目标不保证每个断言有事实依据；更多上下文还会增加处理量和缓存占用。应区分输入长度、输出长度与运行方式，不把长窗口理解成可靠性保证。
answers.en: The generation objective does not guarantee factual support for every claim. More context adds computation and cache use. Distinguish input length, output length and runtime; a long window does not guarantee reliability.

nextTask.zh: 继续看预训练的数据与目标
